title: U.S. company Coupang tips off new NBA season in South Korea
summary: U.S. tech company Coupang brings the 2026-27 NBA season to South Korea via Coupang Play, streaming ~300 games in full HD with multiview and custom audio.
body_markdown:
As a new NBA season tips off in the U.S.,[Coupang Play](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/from-america-to-asia-coupang-is-fueling-south-koreas-obsession-with-u-s-sports/) , the live content streaming service from Seattle-based company Coupang, is bringing live basketball action to millions of fans across South Korea, and sharing American sports culture along the way.


Coupang Play, the U.S. technology company and retailer’s over-the-top (OTT) streaming service, provides customers in Korea with a wide range of American sports and entertainment content, from the NFL and NBA to movies and shows from HBO/Max and Paramount+.


Coupang Play will broadcast three games on opening day, offering an enhanced viewing experience for Korean fans that includes full HD broadcasts and an experienced roster of expert Korean commentators.


[Coupang](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/how-coupang-american-tech-company-went-global/) serves as an important bridge between America and Korea, working with thousands of U.S. companies and brands to drive more than $5 billion in sales and exports of American goods overseas in 2025 alone. The company has also invested billions in technology innovations that benefit both countries, and Coupang Play adds a strong cultural component to the mix.


“Sharing American sports and entertainment like the NBA with our customers in Korea is a great example of how Coupang is serving as a cultural and economic bridge between the U.S. and Korea, bringing the people of our two nations closer together,” said Coupang Chief Global Affairs Officer Rob Porter. “Sports diplomacy is a key focus of the U.S. government to advance U.S. foreign policy priorities through the universal language of sports, and we’re pleased to play a role in advancing that priority.”


Coupang is the primary provider of streaming access to NBA games for Korean audiences.


## **Coupang Play offers exciting new broadcast features to Korean NBA fans**


Coupang Play will apply full HD high-definition to NBA broadcasts this season, expanding the lineup to about 300 games throughout the season, allowing viewers to enjoy a wide variety of NBA teams and players.


Each broadcast will offer convenient features so fans can choose their preferred format: Korean or local English commentary, or live audio without commentary. A “multiview” allows fans to view multiple games simultaneously on a single screen. Broadcasts will include pre-game and post-game commentary and analysis, off-court stories and reporting on the latest NBA news.


Fans in Korea will be able to track the performance of major professional basketball stars playing with new teams, as well as the arrival in the league of highly-touted rookie stars in the making. LeBron James, the four-time NBA Champion and four-time league MVP, left Los Angeles for the Philadelphia 76ers, while Giannis Antetokounmpo, an NBA Champion and two-time MVP, left Milwaukee to sign with the Miami Heat. Potential rookie stars entering the league this year include AJ Dybantsa (Washington Wizards), Darryn Peterson (Utah Jazz) and Cameron Boozer (Memphis Grizzlies).


## **The evolution of Coupang Play**


Coupang Play, which was originally created as an exclusive perk for Coupang’s WOW retail subscription service in Korea, has rapidly evolved into one of Korea’s most dynamic streaming services. In June 2025, Coupang expanded access even further by introducing a free, ad-supported tier, ensuring that anyone with a Coupang account can enjoy a wide variety of entertainment, news, sports, children’s programs and cultural broadcasts.


Coupang Play also serves as a premier destination for cinematic releases, including critically acclaimed original series like Anna, Family Matters, Newtopia, The Affair Was Just the Beginning and global television partnerships. SNL Korea has become the most popular comedy show in Korea with eight recurring seasons on Coupang Play. Through landmark licensing agreements with Warner Bros. Discovery, HBO/Max, Paramount and Sony Pictures, Coupang Play brings Hollywood blockbusters and prestigious global dramas directly to Korean screens.


## **Building sports diplomacy in the U.S.**


As Coupang increasingly serves as a vital economic and cultural bridge between the United States and Korea, the company is also focused on supporting U.S. sports and culture in America.


In 2025,[Coupang announced](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/washington-capitals-announce-coupang-as-home-and-third-jersey-patch-partner/) a multi-year partnership with Monumental Sports and the NHL’s Washington Capitals, sponsoring the team’s home and third jerseys worn for games played at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C. The partnership also includes Coupang branding at the NBA’s Washington Wizards’ games, which are broadcast in Korea on Coupang Play, and the WNBA’s Washington Mystics’s games, highlighting Coupang as an American company that helps share U.S. sports and culture abroad.


## Frequently asked questions


How does Coupang support sports diplomacy between the U.S. and South Korea?


As a Seattle-based company, Coupang acts as an economic and cultural bridge by exporting American sports and entertainment to Korean audiences while driving overseas sales and exports of over $5 billion in U.S. goods in 2025 alone. In the U.S., Coupang also maintains a multi-year partnership with Monumental Sports, sponsoring jerseys for the NHL's Washington Capitals and featuring branding at NBA Washington Wizards and WNBA Washington Mystics games.


What viewing features are available for NBA broadcasts on Coupang Play?


Fans in South Korea can watch games in full HD and use a "multiview" feature to watch multiple games simultaneously on a single screen. Viewers can also customize their audio experience by choosing between Korean commentary, local English commentary, or live arena audio without commentary.


What other U.S. sports and entertainment does Coupang Play offer in South Korea?


Beyond the NBA, Coupang Play streams American professional sports including the NFL, as well as select MLS and F1 events. Through partnerships with Warner Bros. Discovery, HBO/Max, Paramount and Sony Pictures, the platform also features Hollywood movies, global dramas and Korean originals like SNL Korea, Anna and Newtopia.
